structure.unit: Food and Drink; Weights and Measures

law.catch_line: (For expiration date, see Editor's notes) Violations
law.text: No covered farm or farm eligible for a qualified exemption in accordance with 21 C.F.R. § 112.5 shall violate any provision of 21 C.F.R. Part 112 or any provision of a regulation of the Board adopted pursuant to § 3.2-5148.
